citations.narrative:
The facility failed to keep two zebras contained in their primary enclosure.
While traveling in New York, two zebras broke free of their primary enclosure and were found wandering in the circus
parking lot inside the perimeter fence by the local police department. Police officers contacted facility representatives who
were able to recapture the animals without injury. Failure to maintain primary enclosures can result in injury and distress
to the animals.
Housing facilities shall be structurally sound and shall be maintained in good repair to protect the animals from injury and
to contain the animals.
The facilites made corrective actions to prevent further escapes.
Correct by October 3, 2026

At the time of the inspection the facility failed to provide sufficient shade to three zebras.
The zebras primary enclosure was in direct sunlight with a small 10 foot by two foot area of shade that they shared with
two horses. The ambient temperature was in the mid 90s. Failure to provide sufficient shade can cause overheating or
discomfort. At the time of the inspection, the zebras did not show signs of heat distress.
When sunlight is likely to cause overheating or discomfort of the animals, sufficient shade by natural or artificial means
shall be provided to allow all animals kept outdoors to protect themselves from direct sunlight.
The facility corrected it at the time of the inspection by moving their primary enclosure under a fully shaded area.
October 5, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
